sampled.title: 3.1 3.2 補充性限業限量客工治理.doc

terminus.finding: A migration-policy draft describes how quotas, industry restrictions, contract duration, family accompaniment, employer transfer and immigration rights classify migrant workers and make them an explicitly 'unfree' labor force. This is a concrete policy-domain echo of the existing candidate that what is possible is often governed by an access regime or frame rather than physical location alone.
terminus.caution: This may simply be a common feature of regulation. It is not yet evidence of one unified theory across migration governance, activism and imaginary geography.
terminus.counterexampleStatus: No clean counterexample established in this batch.
terminus.next: seek material where physical distance/location itself is causally decisive, to test whether the candidate has been over-generalized
